title: Baseline version manifest
description: The versions a set of repositories agrees to, and how each is held to. Read by check.sh; see README.md. A check that JSON Schema cannot express -- every enforcement entry names a key of fields, and each field sits in exactly one bucket -- is in manifest.bats.

baselineVersion.description: The manifest's own release number. A deviation ADR names it in deviation-from.

fields.description: Dotted field name to agreed value. Every value is a string, a number included. The two required fields are the ones check.sh compares; it stops with a tooling error without them.

policed.description: A file in the consumer must match; the build parent cannot carry the value. check.sh compares maven.wrapper.version only; another entry here states intent and is not checked.

inherited.description: The build parent carries the value; a consumer POM that contradicts it is drift. check.sh compares maven.compiler.release only; the build parent enforces the rest by inheritance, and no check reads them.

informational.description: Published for people and CI images; not checked.

rules.description: Structural checks that need no value. Each id doubles as a deviation ADR's field.
